description:
## [0.6.0-dev.26](https://github.com/dunecache/oyasumi-patches/compare/v0.6.0-dev.25...v0.6.0-dev.26) (2026-10-06)

### ✨ New Features

* **pinterest:** hide the "Ideas you might love" section ([2f13198](https://github.com/dunecache/oyasumi-patches/commit/2f131987e7f6e8a38786c2e0c6600df8020ead5b))
* **pinterest:** hide the create button in the bottom nav bar ([7d239e8](https://github.com/dunecache/oyasumi-patches/commit/7d239e8daf17f4f331c86b1881fcfa71394e0adc))

patches.name: Force Walk & Win steps to 10000
patches.description: Make Djezzy's Walk & Win counter read 10,000 with no walk at all, by forcing the stored step total itself rather than the pedometer event stream. The card's figures are lifetime accumulators read back out of storage, so an event delivered before a walk is never counted.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Skip ADM's Appodeal and AppBrain ad setup and display routines, and the Telegram join prompt.

patches.name: Disable rating prompts
patches.description: Skip ADM's automatic rating prompt. The menu item that opens the same dialog on request is left intact.

patches.name: Increase connection limits
patches.description: Raise the download ceilings to 32 simultaneous downloads and 64 connections per download, and set torrent defaults to 500 global and 100 per torrent.

patches.name: Disable AppsFlyer tracking
patches.description: Neutralize the AppsFlyer attribution SDK, so no state is returned to the external data tracker.

patches.name: Disable email confirmation dialog
patches.description: Hide the "Confirm your email" prompt and related screen, whether in home or settings.

patches.name: Disable Google Engage
patches.description: Stop Pinterest publishing user actions to Google, so nothing is sent to Snooper, Analytics, Play or Ads.

patches.name: Force original image download
patches.description: Load the original full-resolution asset for pin images instead of the 736x rendition, at the cost of considerably more data.

patches.name: Hide "Ideas you might love" section
patches.description: Hide the suggested-topics section shown under a pin.

patches.name: Hide comments
patches.description: Hide the comments button on a pin, so comments cannot be opened from the pin.

patches.name: Hide Create nav button
patches.description: Hide the create (+) button in the bottom navigation bar.

patches.name: Hide Notifications nav button
patches.description: Hide the notifications button in the bottom navigation bar.

patches.name: Hide Search nav button
patches.description: Hide the search button in the bottom navigation bar.

patches.name: Morphe settings entry
patches.description: Add the "Morphe" entry to the Account Settings list, opening the Morphe settings screen.

patches.name: Morphe settings screen (label)
patches.description: Rename the reused string resource to "Morphe" in every shipped language, so the settings entry is identifiable.

patches.name: Morphe settings screen (manifest)
patches.description: Register the Morphe settings activity in the manifest, with an intent-filter for the morphe:// scheme.

patches.name: Neutralize advertising ID
patches.description: Return a random advertising ID instead of the real one, so the app has no advertising identifier to hand to Pinterest or to any bundled tracker.

patches.name: Disable home screen ads
patches.description: Keep the home screen banner from loading, rotating, or rendering. The banner in the footer is Appodeal's, so the ad SDK is never brought up; 1DM's own promo banner, including the built-in "install 1DM+" ad and the server-driven fallback banner (defaultBannerViewNew), is suppressed at its source, never rendered, and its footer slot is collapsed.
